dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: The way the world is now, martial nomads who perform heroic deeds have grown few and far between, and those who seek justice like myself are fewer still.

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: Do not believe those stories written by that village bumpkin in the mountains. Those are not real heroes...

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: I have written my experiences down here. Have a look — they should be enough to clear my name.
